name: The Settlers 7: Paths to a Kingdom - The Two Kings
summary: Venture into new territories and conquer challenging objectives with The Settlers 7: Paths to a Kingdom – The Two Kings DLC! This expansion pack delivers a wealth of fresh content, including a thrilling co-op mode, challenging new maps for strategic city-building and resource management, a cunning new AI opponent, a unique event location, and exciting new victory points to achieve.
